name: flow_fork_tip_explains_passable
description: A fork branch that patches a weak check says what its grade means (playtest halv s1, f4875: 'Lifts Armored to passable', and 'what is passable?'). Design 3.3 grades a Builder strong, passable through a fork branch, or weak on each check, and every Builder can win alone with the right forks: the line is now 'Lifts Swift from weak to passable: one alone holds the early swift waves; later ones need more' (Game.lifts_line: since playtest halv s2, P2, what one tower of the branch holds alone, as patch_lift_words_measured measures it, where it said 'enough to hold it alone'), the same on the Builders screen's kit plate (the glyph beside the Pinning Ballista, on hover) and on the in-match card's branch tooltip, where it wraps on three lines beside its glyph inside the tooltip.

steps.msg: the Lookout's kit plate: the Pinning Ballista's row

steps.assert: node('Kit').get_child(9).tooltip_text == 'Lifts Swift from weak to passable: one alone holds the early swift waves; later ones need more'
steps.msg: its glyph's hover says what passable means

steps.assert: Game.lifts_line('armored') == 'Lifts Armored from weak to passable: one alone holds the early armored waves; later ones need more'
node('Tooltip').visible and node('TooltipHelps').visible and node('TooltipHelpsText').text == 'Lifts Swift from weak to passable: one alone holds the early swift waves; later ones need more'
steps.msg: W's branch tooltip in the match says the same
wrapped on three lines beside its glyph, inside the tooltip, on screen
